headline: Rabobank Sees Favorable Outlook for Brazilian Poultry Despite Newcastle Disease
summary: Rabobank views export prospects for Brazilian chicken meat as favorable despite a third record of Newcastle Disease in Santa Catarina, provided the outbreak remains contained.
why: Agricultural export health protocols and disease containment are critical for maintaining trade access and market valuations for major meat producers.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Localized disease detections pose potential trade restriction risks if infections spread beyond the immediate area.
